Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human MMP-9 (CHEMBL321). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL321, standard_type IC50, and require both canonical_smiles and a pubmed_id or doi. Return molecule_chembl_id aliased as compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication.
